items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Frist: zwei Wochen nach dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) and the delivery date is stamped on the reproduced envelope as 19.09.2025 (Friday); this actual service date is used, not the statutory deemed-delivery fiction. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the period starts the day after service, i.e. 20.09.2025. A two-week period (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB, § 43 StPO via § 46 Abs. 1 OWiG) ends two weeks later on Fri 03.10.2025, which is the Tag der Deutschen Einheit, a public holiday in NW. Under § 43 StPO the period is extended to the next working day, Mon 06.10.2025.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Geldbuße, Gebühr, Auslagen)
items.quote: Zahlung: Gesamtbetrag binnen zwei Wochen ab Rechtskraft auf das unten angegebene Konto (Verwendungszweck: Aktenzeichen).
items.computation: The payment period runs from Rechtskraft (legal force), which — absent an Einspruch — occurs the day after the Einspruch deadline expires, i.e. 07.10.2025 (the day following 06.10.2025). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the two-week payment period starts the next day, 08.10.2025, and ends two weeks later on Tue 21.10.2025 (§ 188 BGB), a normal working day so no shift applies. This assumes no timely Einspruch is filed; if an Einspruch is lodged, the decision is not yet final and this payment deadline does not apply.

warnings: The payment deadline (21.10.2025) assumes no Einspruch is filed by 06.10.2025; if an Einspruch is submitted in time, the fine is not yet legally binding (Rechtskraft) and this payment date does not apply.
The IBAN on the letter (DE34 5205 0000 0000 0034 34) is well-formed but ownership cannot be verified from the letter alone; confirm it matches the Bußgeldstelle's official account before paying.
